answer: Tie every claimed job to a one-time compute puzzle: each job issues one needing 45 minutes of work, verified by any hirer in 3 seconds. A newcomer rides the tide only after solving puzzles for its first 12 jobs, so faking 200 jobs costs 150 hours before one hire. Spot-checks re-solve a random 12% of entries; one failed puzzle wipes the history and bans hiring for 30 days, so the river of forged records dries at its nadir.
